Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Masika "may untap between Methuselahs' turns". Does
a "between turns" window still exist when adjacent
players choose to skip their turns for First Tradition?
("Successful vote means each Methuselah must skip a
turn or burn 2 pool." - btw, is this (Monger) text
up to date? Seems like it'd be clearer as "skip his
or her turn" as the given wording implies that each
player only has to skip one turn. Also the wording
on Monger doesn't explicitly tell you to put the card
in play. Of course, Rumors of Gehenna has the same
problem (at least in Monger and VTES text).)

Thanks,

Josh

gimme gimme untaps

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Joshua Duffin wrote:
>
> Masika "may untap between Methuselahs' turns". Does
> a "between turns" window still exist when adjacent
> players choose to skip their turns for First Tradition?

It exists if another Methuselah ever takes her turn.
Can't end one turn and start another without having
a time for Masika to untap between them.
